title: Is It Really Impossible To Cool A Datacenter In Space?
summary: Scott Manley explains the thermal balance of spacecraft and how a satellite could be configured to radiate away the heat from datacenter-scale computing in space. His rough numbers suggest it is feasible.
why: HN points to it as a convincing energy-budget analysis in debates over space datacenters, while debating its assumptions.

quote.text: the Scott Manley video alas has sort of convinced me this is pretty feasible, that the energy budget is quite doable.
